# Responses upstream reference fixtures

`responses_upstream_expected.json` was generated by executing the unmodified
`relaykit` module from upstream commit
`718a4e7f9751c5bf1958747cd0c2c895e2b937d4` against
`responses_upstream_cases.json`. The local converter did not generate the expected values.

The generator is preserved as `upstream_reference_gen.go.txt` so the application
does not import or depend on upstream relaykit. To regenerate, extract that
commit's `relaykit/` into a temporary directory, copy the generator to
`relaykit/cmd/parity/main.go`, and run from that module:

```text
go run ./cmd/parity <absolute-path-to-cases.json> <absolute-path-to-expected.json>
```

Options enable JSON Schema support and the function-call thought signature
adapter. Each case sets its own loss policy; an empty policy uses upstream's
default `allow`. No network generation request, credential or business database
is involved. Go may download module dependencies.

The projection compares rejection, diagnostic codes, contents, function names,
hosted tools and tool configuration. It excludes host safety defaults, schema
wire dialect and diagnostic wording. Other request/media and JSON/SSE response
semantics are covered in `responses_parity_test.go`; billing, refunds and
diagnostic logs are checked through local HTTP and temporary SQLite tests in
`controller/relay_gemini_responses_policy_test.go`.
